description.value:
Requirements You wield a gunblade.

You adopt the protective posture of Gunnhildr's guard. Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC while in this stance, and enemies within 5 feet of you are Challenged: they take a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than a Gunbreaker in Royal Guard. Your damage is unchanged. The stance ends if you cease wielding a gunblade, become unconscious, or combat ends. Your Heart of Stone reaction works with or without the stance.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.a74a5130c0f43674]{Royal Guard (Stance)}. The Gunbreaker console applies it; its aura challenges enemies automatically.
